items: Project templates: mark a project as a template and create a new week from it with all its tasks (admins).
Every project now has time fields, Hours Est and Hours Fact. They can be hidden but not deleted.
"Leave this page?" now lists the unsaved drafts by name.
MCP: listing tasks by project includes tasks linked from other projects, and adding a task to a project can move it to a section.
What's new: this page lists what has changed in Workloom, and a short note offers to open it when something new arrives.
Tasks shown from another project now sit in their sections in the table, marked as linked.
Linked tasks can be dragged and reordered together with the project's own tasks.
Making another project a task's home moves its field values, so hours are no longer counted twice.
The task card shows one list of projects, with one home where hours count and a "Make home" action.
API and MCP: add an existing task to another project, for example from the backlog to a week, and choose its home.
Reports: hours of unassigned subtasks now count for the parent task's assignee.
Drop files onto an open task to attach them. Files dropped into a description appear where you drop them, and attachments show in the task's activity.
AI assistants: new MCP tools for custom fields and weekly time, and apps can connect to Workloom's MCP by signing in instead of using a token.
A new dark profile theme, Omnissiah.
My tasks has a Today section and a Tomorrow group.
Quick Jump searches all tasks you can see, and the command palette creates several tasks in a row.
Pin projects and reports, and get back to recent work quickly.
Inbox: save, archive and mark items as unread. Due date changes show there too.
Type to find and link tasks and projects in descriptions and comments. Workloom links show as task and project names.
Create linked follow-up tasks, also straight from a comment, and change a task's parent.
Save personal and shared views of a project, and paste several lines to create tasks in a section after a preview.
Move a task with its subtasks to another project from the task pane, with a one-click way back.
The task pane shows a compact Projects block.
Asana import: choose to leave archived tags off the imported tasks.
Select table rows by clicking task names or dragging over them. The bulk bar appears from two selected rows.
Changes to dates, status, assignee and tags show in the row at once, before the server answers.
Archive a project with a confirmation, find it on the Archive page, or delete it permanently.
Asana import: decide about assignees and shared tasks, and import again cleanly after a delete.
Faster live updates and project loading. Clicking a tag name in the tag picker now toggles the tag.

days.title: Workloom launched
items: Projects with sections, statuses, tags and custom fields. A task table you edit like a spreadsheet, plus Board, Timeline and Graph views.
Tasks with subtasks, dependencies, comments, attachments and history. Most edits can be undone.
Time: estimates and facts, time off and working schedules, and project and workspace reports.
My tasks, Inbox and Quick Jump to keep track of your work.
Members with roles and invitations.
Import from Asana.
A public API and MCP with personal access tokens, so AI assistants can read and update tasks.
